properties.statement: [BL-210] adopt REGISTERS documents and nothing READS them — so intent recovery is fed a list of filenames, and 1,124 documents produced 9 requirements
properties.value: {"evidence": "*Anthony, 2026-08-04, from running it: \"when I first ran the reflow2 adopt skill on dev_storyflow, it did a very lazy job of actually reviewing any of these documents. I think it just kind of acknowledged the files were there.\"* It is not the agent being lazy \u2014 it is the skill working exactly as written. Phase 0 says *\"list what else exists, because intent lives outside the implementation\u2026 Record each source as a Fragment\"*; Phase 3 says *\"Requirements come only from Phase 0's non-code sources.\"* So intent recovery is fed exclusively by documents, and the only operation the skill prescribes on a document is LISTING it. There is no read step anywhere in adopt. MEASURED, from the fleet's own baseline memory: ~124 nodes / 177 edges \u2026 9 Requirements + 3 Constraints \u2026 17 Fragments (Phase-0 provenance ledger) \u2014 against 1,124 markdown files. Their own verdict, unprompted: *\"The adopt baseline captured what the system is made of (services, contracts, components); it captured almost none of what it is for. The intent lives in the docs.\"* THE COST IS ALREADY PAID: a separate multi-session campaign (project_reflow2_doc_intent_sweep, on a user directive of 2026-07-25) had to read ~275 documents BY HAND to do what the skill should have done \u2014 and that campaign's IN/OUT scope table is now the only human-validated benchmark we have for judging a mass-ingest strategy, so it is worth keeping. The fix is not new prose in adopt; it is adopt CONSUMING [BL-186]'s mass ingest at Phase 0 \u2014 see [req:accreted-intent-becomes-a-design], which records that mass ingest sits UNDER adopt and genesis rather than beside them. Note the trap this closes and the one it opens: adopt's own granularity rule (*a directory artifact claims its subtree*) is what let 359 files read as registered while being individually invisible \u2014 the finding behind [BL-188] \u2014 so whatever adopt does with a doc corpus must mark what it did not descend into as pending_expansion, not leave it opaque.
